_ref: Tim, 2026-09-20, "Re: Phase 2 feed build" item 2: add a matched-vs-designed count guard. The automated local feed served 46 offers short for two weeks in silence because nothing compared Merchant Center's matched count against the designed count.
_how_to_update: Every number here is a deliberate, dated expectation, not a cache of the last run. When a ruling changes scope, edit this file in the SAME commit as the scope change and move the as_of date. A run that disagrees with this file fails; that is the point.
_precedence: scripts/check_expected_counts.py reads build/feeds/run_manifest.json from the generator and compares it here. Merchant Center's matched count is supplied at check time with --matched, because the generator has no Merchant Center access and should not pretend to.

catalogue.note: The page loop must return exactly what Shopify's productsCount reports for the same filter. Any shortfall is the 250-item pagination clamp class of bug and fails the run inside the generator itself. Live read 2026-09-20: 3757 active products.

googleshoppingfrenchfitness.note: 861 generated on 2026-09-09 against 966 live; 970 live on 2026-09-17. The band is wide because the composite-variant expansion and the exclusion fixes both move it, and because the catalog-additions scope is still growing. It is a floor against shipping short, not a target.

googleshoppingfs.note: 1783 generated on 2026-09-09 against 1537 live. Same reasoning.

p_under_100_rows.note: Tim 2026-09-19 OPTION A SCOPED, confirmed 2026-09-19: the committed 12-row roster, not the 431 catalogue-wide. Exact, because this one is a closed list and any drift is a defect.

promotion_rows.note: feeds/promotion-map.csv carries 17 SKUs including FF-FSR100. Rises to the full expanded list in one pass when Ilsaa posts it on the WASP thread. A promotion row missing from the feed strips a live badge, so this is a floor.

matched_vs_designed.note: Merchant Center matched must equal designed. Supply it with --matched <feed>=<count> from the Merchant Center source page after a fetch. 46 short for two weeks is what a tolerance above zero buys you.

catalog_additions._ref: Tim, 2026-09-20, "Re: Phase 2 feed build" item 1: GO, the 31 French Fitness variants at $100 and over from the 439 missing-primary-offer set enter the catalog-additions scope, alongside the 55 missing master SKUs already queued.
catalog_additions._measured_as: Rows the id diff codes added:new_offer, i.e. a SKU with no counterpart anywhere in the live export. added:variant_expansion and rekeyed:* are the composite-id work, not catalog additions, and are excluded.
catalog_additions._source: 439 absent from all four primaries, split by Izza on the local inventory thread 2026-09-19: 31 at $100 and over (IN, unconditional), 285 at $26-99 (OUT, floor stands), 123 at $4-24 (OUT, sub-$25 cut). The p_under_100 exception stays the committed 12-row roster and does not extend to the 285.
catalog_additions._pending: Izza has not posted the 31 SKUs themselves. Until that list lands this is a count expectation, not a roster: the guard proves the right NUMBER of catalog additions landed, not yet that they are the right 31.
catalog_additions._combined_note: 31 French Fitness variants at $100 and over plus the 55 queued master SKUs. This one WARNS rather than fails: the 31 are unconditional, but the 55 pre-date this GO and at least one of them cannot emit (FF-RIT24 is $16 and the floor drops it), so a hard combined floor would false-fail a correct run.
